source_of_truth: A trusted monitor or deployment provider must deliver authenticated evidence. Browser-side telemetry never authorizes a release or rollback.

synthetic_availability.breach_when: two or more independent probes fail within the window
synthetic_availability.required_action: hold release and request rollback review

content_security_policy.breach_when: one confirmed CSP enforcement violation from the deployed portal
content_security_policy.required_action: hold release and require Security Reviewer triage

uncaught_client_error.breach_when: five or more uncaught errors across at least three privacy-preserving session identifiers
uncaught_client_error.required_action: hold release and require Maintainer triage

governance_integrity.breach_when: release SHA, property ID, required approval, or rollback reference does not match the attested release record
governance_integrity.required_action: block further promotion and require Entity Steward review
